title: Lilly confident in slow and steady Foundayo launch, as ex-US sales shine
snippet: Foundayo clocked $98 million in sales in Q2, the first quarter it was available, compared to Novo’s $355 million for the same sales period.

title: Lilly, FDA retatrutide biologic dispute comes to a head as submission nears
snippet: A legal dispute between the FDA and Eli Lilly over whether the highly anticipated obesity candidate retatrutide is indeed a biologic has come to a head as the company prepares to submit the medicine for approval.

title: No deal between AstraZeneca and BMS, senior source insists: Reuters
snippet: Reuters has deflated rumors that AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb are discussing a possible merger, letting the air out of industry-wide speculation over what could have been the largest deal in pharma history.

title: Bespoke gene-editing outfit abandons lead program, cuts ‘several’ employees
snippet: Seven months after launching with $16 million in seed financing, Jennifer Doudna’s Aurora Therapeutics is pivoting away from its lead indication, phenylketonuria, owing to growing competition in the field.

title: Over 1/3 stay in biopharma jobs for health insurance, poll finds
snippet: A recruiter and career coach discuss when and why some biotech and pharma professionals put a premium on health insurance benefits.

title: Chaotic adcomms threaten to derail FDA’s bid to renew trust after Makary, Prasad
snippet: The FDA has been trying to mend fences with rare disease drug developers and patient groups since the departure of former Commissioner Marty Makary three months ago. But advisory committee meetings last week for Replimune and Capricor Therapeutics only created more confusion and frustration.
